question_en:
The attachment is a text-free crop of an official packaging image for a US food product. Please answer the following three parts in order:

1. What are the brand, product line, and flavor of the food in the image? Please find the catalog for the same product series on the manufacturer's official US website, and list all active individual flavors marked in that version of the catalog. Merge different sizes of the same flavor; do not count variety packs as separate flavors.
2. For each candidate listed in Part 1, uniformly check the default front-of-pack image on the product page linked in that version of the catalog. Which products have a right-side flavor panel with a main color of red, maroon, or brown, and feature at least one ingredient illustration between the oat bar and the left edge of the panel? Green or orange panels do not count. Please list the names of all products that meet these criteria.
3. Among the products filtered in Part 2, based on the ingredients, allergen information, and nutrition labels in the same version of the product records, which products contain no milk in their ingredients and allergen statements, and have no more than 5 g of added sugar per labeled serving? Please provide the names of the final products that meet these criteria.

Answer format: For Part 1, provide the brand, product line, flavor, and official catalog link in text, and list all active individual flavors; for Part 2 and Part 3, list the names of the products meeting the appearance criteria and the final qualifying products, respectively, in text.
answer:
Part 1: Brand: Nature Valley; Product Line: Crunchy Bars; Flavor: Oats 'n Honey.
Official Catalog: https://www.naturevalley.com/products/crunchy-bars
Active Individual Flavors: Apple Crisp; Cinnamon; Maple Brown Sugar; Oats 'n Dark Chocolate; Oats 'n Honey; Peanut Butter; Peanut Butter Dark Chocolate; Pecan.

Part 2: Apple Crisp Crunchy Granola Bars; Cinnamon Crunchy Granola Bars; Maple Brown Sugar Crunchy Granola Bars; Oats 'n Dark Chocolate Crunchy Granola Bars; Pecan Crunchy Granola Bars.

Part 3: Apple Crisp Crunchy Granola Bars.
